title: A 991-LUT implementation of the EPFL sine benchmark
description: A netlist of the sin benchmark of the EPFL combinational benchmark suite with 991 LUTs of at most 6 inputs and 103 levels, checked exhaustively on all 2^24 inputs. It starts from the 994-LUT netlist of F.-X. Reichl and F. Slivovsky published in lsils/benchmarks and applies one standard ABC pass.
